question: Does a three-species food chain forget its initial state at its largest Lyapunov exponent, as the predictability law states?

provenance.source: A. Hastings and T. Powell, Ecology 72, 896 (1991)

name: three-species food chain (Hastings-Powell)

carrier.name: dimensionless densities of resource x, consumer y and predator z

closure: well-mixed chain with a saturating functional response at both levels; no input from outside
assumptions: the parameter values of the paper, with b1 = 3
